verbs.name: project.group_preview
verbs.description: Inspect one existing adjacent compound action before rejecting it. The supplied op must carry a durable group_id and belong to an adjacent multi-operation timeline action in the active sequence. The read returns the exact ordered operation boundary, current project revision, and an opaque preview_hash. A group remains inspectable after newer edits, but reject is ready only when it is the live undo-history tip; this verb never changes the project or replays transactions.

op_id.description: Any operation id within the adjacent durable compound action to inspect.

verbs.result: {schema:'shellx-cut/compound-action-preview/1',project_revision,preview_hash,group:{group_id,first_op_id,last_op_id,op_ids,operation_count,sequence_id},reject:{status:'ready'|'not_current_tip',mode?:'tip_only',current_tip_op_id?,message}}. The preview is read-only; only ready may be passed unchanged to project.group_reject.

verbs.name: project.group_reject
verbs.description: Reject exactly one currently live adjacent compound action after project.group_preview. Requires request_id, expected_revision, the exact first/last operation ids, and unchanged preview_hash. It is tip-only: Cut appends one normal replayable edit.restore record with the materialized prefix before the group. It never skips, reorders, or generically replays selected historical operations; newer timeline history, a changed boundary, a stale revision, or a changed preview refuses without appending.

preview_hash.description: Exact opaque preview_hash returned by project.group_preview.

verbs.result: {schema:'shellx-cut/compound-action-reject/1',pre_revision,post_revision,group:{group_id,first_op_id,last_op_id,op_ids,operation_count,sequence_id},restored_op_id,restore_op_id,scope:{mode:'tip_only',append_only:true,replay:'materialized_prefix_before_group',generic_transaction_replay:false,undo}} plus one restore op id. An identical lost-response retry returns this original durable response; one project.undo restores the complete group.
